info.title: Admin API
info.description: Built-in labels and descriptions follow the `Accept-Language` request header (`en-US` or `zh-CN`, English by default). Fixed codes in responses (statuses, categories, actions, roles, module keys…) are enums: map them to text in the frontend

name.description: Original file name, used for downloads

allOf.description: The uploader; null when they have been deleted
